improvements.title: Write the body right in the JSON
improvements.summary: Short notes go in a body field instead of a file
improvements.body:
A short improvement note does not need its own file. Write it in `body`.

- Plain markdown
- Line breaks as `\n`

Move it to `file` when it grows.

projects.title: pixel-portfolio
projects.summary: A pixel-art portfolio template built from one JSON file and a few markdown pages. One button switches between 240p and 4K
projects.about:
A portfolio template you can drop on any static host with no build step. A small client-side router draws the project list, improvement write-ups and dev log; in 240p mode you get a pixel font, chunky thumbnails and a boot screen.

- Data: one `data/portfolio.json` plus markdown under `content/`
- Theme: colors, fonts, radii and shadows are CSS variables
- Check: `npm run check` catches duplicate ids, missing files and bad dates
